parts.text:
Extract the shared tool modules (Tools.FileSystem, Tools.EditFile, Tools.Messages, Tools.ScopeGuard, Tools.AgentLogger) from agents/code/code.exs and agents/goal/goal.exs into dedicated files under lib/iex_claw/tools/ if not already there, then update both agents to import from lib.

Steps:
1. Read agents/code/code.exs and agents/goal/goal.exs to identify all tool module definitions (Tools.FileSystem, Tools.EditFile, Tools.Messages, Tools.ScopeGuard, Tools.AgentLogger).
2. Check if lib/iex_claw/tools/ directory and any of these files already exist.
3. For each tool module, create a dedicated file under lib/iex_claw/tools/ (e.g., lib/iex_claw/tools/file_system.ex, lib/iex_claw/tools/edit_file.ex, lib/iex_claw/tools/messages.ex, lib/iex_claw/tools/scope_guard.ex, lib/iex_claw/tools/agent_logger.ex). Use the IexClaw.Tools namespace (e.g., defmodule IexClaw.Tools.FileSystem).
4. Update both agents/code/code.exs and agents/goal/goal.exs to import/use the extracted modules from lib instead of defining them inline.
5. Ensure no functionality is lost — all function signatures, docs, and logic must be preserved exactly.
6. If there are any differences between the same tool module in code.exs vs goal.exs, reconcile them (prefer the more complete version, or note the differences).

Context:
The repo is at reification-labs/iex-claw. The two agent files are agents/code/code.exs and agents/goal/goal.exs. These contain inline tool module definitions that should be extracted to lib/iex_claw/tools/ for reuse and to eliminate duplication.
